title: Fix Coda Desktop Engine Integration
description: No properties are shown in the coda desktop UI. The resource mapping in main.ts is missing coda://properties and coda://frameworks entries. The engine coda.py is also missing sidecar method registrations for get_properties and get_frameworks. Need to add these mappings and sidecar methods so the UI can fetch and display all properties including measures for all measure kinds with instructions.
summary: Fixed properties not showing in coda desktop UI. Root cause: missing resource mapping and sidecar methods for coda://properties and coda://frameworks. Changes: (1) Added get_properties and get_frameworks sidecar methods to coda.py with proper normalization. (2) Added coda://properties and coda://frameworks entries to resourceMapping in main.ts. (3) Fixed Level interface and PropertyView to use canonical raise/lower keys instead of higher/lower, matching engine normalization. (4) Added instructions normalization (higher→raise) in engine. (5) Fixed get_platforms sidecar to fall back to coda.json when .coda/platforms/ directory is empty or missing.
